Topics · Death and what comes after

Why do we long for justice that never comes?

'Not fair' comes early and stays. Longing alone proves nothing. The Quran sees a sign beyond and a task today.

Part 1 of 3

﴿وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلْمِيزَانَ٧ أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْمِيزَانِ٨ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ٩﴾

Translation of the meaning

And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance That you not transgress within the balance. And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.

Quran · Ar-Rahman 55:7-9

Translation

“‘You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity. You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin. I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.

Original · Hebrew

לֹא־תַעֲשׂ֥וּ עָ֖וֶל בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט בַּמִּדָּ֕ה בַּמִּשְׁקָ֖ל וּבַמְּשׂוּרָֽה׃ מֹ֧אזְנֵי צֶ֣דֶק אַבְנֵי־צֶ֗דֶק אֵ֥יפַת צֶ֛דֶק וְהִ֥ין צֶ֖דֶק יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם אֲנִי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־הוֹצֵ֥אתִי אֶתְכֶ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

the Torah (Leviticus) · 19:35-36

World English Bible

You have heard a small child say 'that's not fair' before she can tie her shoes. We do not grow out of it. We protest wrongs done to strangers in countries we will never see, when it gains us nothing. Where does a demand like that come from? These verses set a balance alongside the raised sky, then tell people not to cheat it. In this picture, fairness is no local habit. It belongs to how things were set up, and an injured person's cry reports something real.

A question for you

What does your longing for justice seem to you?

If you sayA feeling evolution gave us.
ThenThat may explain its origin. It is still worth asking whether you would then let it go.
If you sayA sign the world should be otherwise.
ThenThen you hold a standard the world does not meet, which is where the next part begins.
If you sayA wound.
ThenIt may be that before it is anything else. Nothing here asks you to make it smaller.

Part 2 of 3

﴿أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ كَٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلْفُجَّارِ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Or should We treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allāh like the wicked?

Quran · Sad 38:28

Translation

Then you shall return and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him who serves God and him who doesn’t serve him.

Original · Hebrew

וְשַׁבְתֶּם֙ וּרְאִיתֶ֔ם בֵּ֥ין צַדִּ֖יק לְרָשָׁ֑ע בֵּ֚ין עֹבֵ֣ד אֱלֹהִ֔ים לַאֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֥א עֲבָדֽוֹ׃

Malachi · 3:18

World English Bible

The Quran asks: shall those who do good be treated like those who spread ruin? Almost no one says yes. Now the difficulty: in this life they very often are. So there are three options. The longing is a mistake, and the world never owed anything. Or it is real and will never be met. Or it is real and will be. A longing alone proves nothing: hunger does not prove a meal. The book takes the third, and asks whether you can hold the first two.

A question for you

Which of the three can you hold?

If you sayThe longing is a mistake.
ThenThen the account is never settled. Some people hold this with courage, and it asks a great deal.
If you sayIt is real, and will never be met.
ThenThat is a hard and honest place, and many have stood in it.
If you sayIt is real, and will be met.
ThenThat is the book's own claim, and another Step takes it further.
If you sayI do not know.
ThenAn honest answer. The next part does not need you to know.

Part 3 of 3

﴿ٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ ۚ لَا ظُلْمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ﴾

Translation of the meaning

This Day every soul will be recompensed for what it earned. No injustice today! Indeed, Allāh is swift in account.

Quran · Ghafir 40:17

﴿لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ وَأَنزَلْنَا مَعَهُمُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ لِيَقُومَ ٱلنَّاسُ بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۖ وَأَنزَلْنَا ٱلْحَدِيدَ فِيهِ بَأْسٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَنَـٰفِعُ لِلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُۥ وَرُسُلَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

We have already sent Our messengers with clear evidences and sent down with them the Scripture and the balance that the people may maintain [their affairs] in justice. And We sent down iron, wherein is great military might and benefits for the people, and so that Allāh may make evident those who support Him and His messengers unseen. Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and Exalted in Might.

Quran · Al-Hadid 57:25

Translation

Yahweh says: “Maintain justice and do what is right, for my salvation is near and my righteousness will soon be revealed.

Original · Hebrew

כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה שִׁמְר֥וּ מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וַעֲשׂ֣וּ צְדָקָ֑ה כִּֽי־קְרוֹבָ֤ה יְשֽׁוּעָתִי֙ לָב֔וֹא וְצִדְקָתִ֖י לְהִגָּלֽוֹת׃

Isaiah · 56:1

World English Bible

The book says two things about where this longing goes. One concerns the end: a day of which it is said, no wrong today. Each soul receives what it earned, and no wronged person is forgotten. The other concerns now: messengers and the scale were sent so that people would uphold justice themselves. So the longing is both a hope and a task. Waiting for the last court gives no one leave to stop. If the world is unfair, the question is also what your hands will do.

A question for you

What does your longing ask of you now?

If you sayTo wait, and trust.
ThenThat is one half of what these verses say.
If you sayTo act, where I can.
ThenThat is the other half.
If you sayTo be heard first.
ThenThat comes before either. Someone has to listen.

The same in the other books

Translation

Yahweh detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing.

Original · Hebrew

תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה אֶ֣בֶן וָאָ֑בֶן וּמֹאזְנֵ֖י מִרְמָ֣ה לֹא־טֽוֹב׃

Proverbs · 20:23

World English Bible

Translation

the Psalms · 106:3

World English Bible

I will make justice the measuring line, and righteousness the plumb line. The hail will sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters will overflow the hiding place.

Original · Hebrew

וְשַׂמְתִּ֤י מִשְׁפָּט֙ לְקָ֔ו וּצְדָקָ֖ה לְמִשְׁקָ֑לֶת וְיָעָ֤ה בָרָד֙ מַחְסֵ֣ה כָזָ֔ב וְסֵ֥תֶר מַ֖יִם יִשְׁטֹֽפוּ׃

Isaiah · 28:17

World English Bible
